name: NUO OS v1.4.7
notes: New: Luo Tianyi (洛天依) joins Vocaloid mode — the settings card and background theme use her official full-body design illustration, while the floating ball rotates three chibi faces and pops up her own playful lines; the AI replies in her tone too. Changed: Vocaloid mode now automatically switches to the next character each time you open the app window, so Miku, Teto, Rei and Tianyi take turns.
